We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get carbon NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons? Could also get HSQC etc. But maybe simpler: use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get list of carbon chemical shifts; aromatic carbons appear in typical range ~110-160 ppm. Count peaks in that range.

We need to call carbon_nmr_spectra.
